test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of boys in 8 schools. The total number of boys in all these 8 schools is 8000. The number of boys in a particular school is shown as a percent of a total number of boys in all these 8 schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7c8e96164d36e61724fc9858ddc97eaff034b49bcc25227f03d49fe54a99fa6.png] 

What is the sum of the average number of boys in P. R. T and W and the average number of boys in Q and V?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average of P, R, Tand W = 7 + 8 + 17 + 3 = 35/4%

Average of Q and V = 37 + 5 = 42/2% = 21%

According to the question

35/4 + 21 = (35 + 84)/4

 (35 + 84)/4 × 8000 = 2380

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
